end.summary:
Practised sorting objects by rolling, sliding, and stacking features.
Anika identified a book as flat and sliding rather than rolling (turn 4).
They noticed a tin can can slide when upright and roll when placed on its side (turns 3, 5).
The belief that only balls roll remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised noticing whether a surface is curved or flat, using a tin, book, and bottle. They explained that a tin can slide when upright and move by rolling on its side; the mix-up that only balls roll was still present at the end. At home, try gently rolling a bottle, can, and ball, then ask which curved surface touched the floor.
